newsitem.title: FRANCE: Matif prices on Reuters disrupted, technical fault.
newsitem.headline: Matif prices on Reuters disrupted, technical fault.

text.p: French futures and options exchange MATIF said on Tuesday prices from its open outcry session were not being quoted on Reuters screens due to technical difficulties.
A Matif spokeswoman said the problem applied only to Reuters.
She said technicians were dealing with the problem but she did not know when it would be resolved.
